decision_1.question: Should we scrap existing changesets for v0.2.0?

options.A: Scrap all existing changesets, create new ones aligned with BASE-APP-OPTIMIZATION
options.B: Modify existing changesets to reflect new architecture
options.C: Keep existing changesets, add new ones for base OS integration

rationale: Existing changesets were v0.1.7 emergency fixes (already released)
New architecture represents fundamental breaking changes
Clean slate allows proper semver communication (v0.2.0 → v1.0.0 breaking)
Avoids confusion with old emergency fix changesets
decision_1.action: Archive old changesets to .orchestrator/old-changesets/, create fresh changesets

decision_2.question: How to handle base OS dependency in v0.2.0?

options.B: Add fallback for systems without base OS

rationale: No point supporting old architecture (technical debt)
v0.2.0 → v1.0.0 is perfect opportunity for breaking change
Clear separation of concerns benefits long-term maintainability

decision_3.question: Should Phase 2 wait for base OS repo work?

options.A: Wait for escapeplan-base v1.0.0 to be built
options.B: Proceed with app changes, assume base OS will be ready
options.C: Work on both repos in parallel

rationale: App changes are self-contained (removing code, not adding)
Can test with mocked base OS verification
Base OS work can happen in parallel by different team
